newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 7-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 7-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system through a round of term system repurchase agreements.
Analysts said seven-day system RPs would be the most likely to cover the long holiday weekend and then some.
The operation may come earlier than the usual 1030 EDT/1430 period due to the early close in the market.
With the new maintenance period beginning today, the Fed is projected to face an average daily add need of $6-7 billion.
Analysts noted that with Treasury balances at the Fed expected to remain stable through the period, there is no reason for thr Fed to confine its operation to less than a week.
In early trading, federal funds were at 5-7/16 percent, below the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
